message.content: {"appearance_facts": [{"location": "top center", "fact": "The chart title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'."}, {"location": "left side", "fact": "The vertical y-axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' with tick marks ranging from 0 to 3,500 in increments of 500."}, {"location": "bottom", "fact": "The horizontal x-axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for every year from 1880 to 1891."}, {"location": "plot area", "fact": "A single blue line chart connects data points for each year, showing a general upward trend from 1880 to 1890, with a slight dip in 1891."}, {"location": "1880", "fact": "The line starts at a y-value of 1,000."}, {"location": "1890", "fact": "The line reaches its peak at a y-value of approximately 3,300."}, {"location": "1891", "fact": "The line ends at a y-value of approximately 2,900."}], "printed_facts": [{"location": "y-axis", "fact": "Scale: 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500, 3,000, 3,500."}, {"location": "x-axis", "fact": "Scale: 1880, 1881, 1882, 1883, 1884, 1885, 1886, 1887, 1888, 1889, 1890, 1891."}, {"location": "1880", "fact": "Data point: 1,000."}, {"location": "1881", "fact": "Data point: ~1,400."}, {"location": "1882", "fact": "Data point: ~1,300."}, {"location": "1883", "fact": "Data point: ~1,500."}, {"location": "1884", "fact": "Data point: ~2,000."}, {"location": "1885", "fact": "Data point: ~2,050."}], "public_definitions": [], "uncertain": []}
